title: Sum of all algebraic normal form coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb F_2$. The sum of all algebraic normal form coefficients of $f$ equals the sum of the values of $f$ over all inputs in the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
